criteria.evidence: Section 1 explicitly says to confirm 'the exact payload sent back to the LLM in the follow-up call' and lists possible handoff breaks like message never appended, wrong role, serialization bugs.
criteria.criterion: Inspect the Agent App to LLM tool-result handoff.

criteria.evidence: Section 3 instructs: 'Add a log right before the final generation call showing the entire message array sent to the model' to see if tool output is present or malformed.
criteria.criterion: Check the actual messages sent to the second LLM call.

criteria.evidence: The response never suggests modifying the weather tool itself; it repeatedly frames the issue as 'an application-logic bug in how the tool result flows into the next LLM call, not a model capability issue' and focuses entirely on tracing the handoff before proposing any fix.
criteria.criterion: Avoid changing the tool before tracing the boundary.
